purpose: Check the instrument, not a strategy: error rate (chance pass) and power of the S1 DEV search pipeline (strong_search_dev Track A + Track B, 3,857 trials) on synthetic data. Real market time read: S1 only (2021-01-01..2023-09-18, six IW1-A symbols). No validation, locked, IW1 or paper time.
pilot_note: Only these pilots were run before this file: (1) the pipeline on real S1 (reproduces ADR 0019: 3,795+62 trials, best SR 1.04, PBO 0.07) and one day-sign surrogate (best 1.55) to time it; (2) the delta calibration below on pilot seeds 9001-9003 (day-sign). No results of the groups below were seen.

generators.day: sign of price moves flipped per UTC day, common to all symbols
generators.bar: sign flipped per 15m bar, common to all symbols
generators.bar_ind: sign flipped per bar and symbol independently
generators.real: identity (used only for the reproduction pilot)

calibration.method: delta (log bp per trade, side-signed, spread over the holding bars) chosen so the planted rule's own S1 annual SR (equal-weight six symbols, assumed_public_v1 cost) averages the target over day-sign pilot seeds 9001-9003; delta then fixed

planted_seed_note: planted run k uses the same sign path as null_day rep k (paired), so detection can be compared with the same noise without the edge

metrics.a_formula_check: For each null group: mean, median, 5th/95th percentile of the best S1 SR over trials; compare with emax_unit_all (Bailey, N=trials, unit variance, ~2.30) and emax_unit_eff (N=participation-ratio effective trials, ~1.6). Verdict per group: 'conservative' if the empirical 95th percentile < the formula value; 'about right' if the formula value lies between the empirical median and 95th percentile; 'anti-conservative' if the empirical median > the formula value. Gross groups (cost_mult 0) are the like-for-like check of the formula's zero-mean assumption; net groups show the effect of cost.
metrics.a_chance_pass: Share of null runs (with Wilson 95% CI) whose best SR reaches T for T in {1.0 (v2 entry bar), 1.5, 2.0, 2.8 (IW1 power bar)}; also share with the repo's DSR(all trials) >= 0.95.
metrics.a_real_vs_null: Percentile of the real S1 best SR (1.04) within each net null group's best-SR distribution.
metrics.b_power: For each planted level: share of runs with best SR >= 1.0, >= 1.5; share where a series with correlation >= 0.5 to P is in the top 10 by SR (p_like_in_top10); share where P's own rank <= 25; median realized SR of P; 'caught' = p_like_in_top10 AND best SR >= the 95th percentile of null_day best SR (threshold fixed from the null_day group, computed before looking at planted runs).
limits_to_report: surrogates are exchangeable in SIGN only; any real predictability in the true series (it is what we search for) is by construction absent, and the sign-flip null cannot reproduce a real-world non-exchangeable structure (volatility-return leverage effect, trend regimes); the null therefore tests the multiple-testing arithmetic under vol clustering and fat tails, not the market
the eight earlier human-in-the-loop looks and the evolve engine DEV screen / validation gates are not simulated here; validation power is ADR 0022
the planted edge is a constant per-trade drift on one rule, the easiest kind of edge to find

no_effect: No criterion, cost profile, preregistration v2/v3, gate or window changes. Nothing activated; no validation, locked, IW1 or paper time opened.
